metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Astro - desktop notifications and productivity hooks

plugins.name: agent-toast
plugins.description: Windows toast notification on Claude Code Stop event. No module install, ThreatLocker-safe. Configurable name, icon, beep.

plugins.name: claude-multi-agent-flow
plugins.description: Parallel backlog stories, one git worktree (berth) per story. Claude Code builds, Codex CLI reviews read-only, a human merges. Ships berth bootstrap, risk-routed review, exclusive-resource locks, a WIP cap, a serialised landing queue, a merge-gated close, and a board derived from git rather than agent self-reports.
